interpretation.purpose: Research-wide screening of model and selective-policy behavior across every exported label
interpretation.sparse_label_rule: All labels receive model metrics; selective policies are not fitted below the patient-count eligibility boundary
interpretation.shared_constraint_warning: The common risk limits are engineering comparison anchors, not diagnosis-specific clinical harm thresholds
interpretation.test_reuse_warning: The test fold has already been inspected for AFIB, so all-label results are post-hoc and require untouched external data for confirmation
interpretation.claim_boundary: Not a clinical diagnosis, deployment authorization, or evidence that one risk tradeoff is appropriate for every diagnosis
